name: Stock price
description: The current price of a stock or index from Google Finance: name, price, today's change, previous close and the time of the quote.

symbol.description: ticker and exchange as Google Finance writes them, e.g. RELIANCE:NSE, TCS:NSE, INFY:NSE, AAPL:NASDAQ, NIFTY_50:INDEXNSE

notes: Checked on google.com/finance (Nov 2026): the page's class names are generated, so the flow reads the top of the page (name, price, change, date, previous close) as text.
